words: Up to 1150 US cents is the most I can lay out - no more than that, now. Then it has to be available to order today - that's the rule I'm working to, so nothing that's only coming later. Hi there! I'm hoping to buy a formal one - and the water resistance on it should read 5bar. And sure that's the reason I'm onto this now - the old one gave up the ghost after the paddling pool day with the kids last week. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. Two small lads and a job in the parish office keep me running from one thing to the next - the days grow faster than the weeds in May. We've 40 steps - then we're finished - done or not. Anything that suits the bill will do me grand for Mass and the meetings.
